# Strategic Machines

> Strategic Machines builds the Accelerator: an expert AI crew, trained for your industry,
> that improves your website under your direction. Every change is a defined work package:
> the request, the design you approved, the plan, the tests that proved it, your decisions
> and the release, kept together as a lasting record. The platform is in preview and is
> delivering on Machine Shop, our commerce test site.

## Core facts

- One accountable team lead coordinates specialists (designer, planner, builder, judge,
  release). The client sets priorities and approves consequential decisions.
- Every request is rated by what is at stake. Simple fixes ship on their own after every
  check passes; standard changes need a one-page brief; anything touching money, customer
  data, sign-in or security stops for the owner at the design, the plan, the preview and
  the release.
- Every step adds tests, and nothing moves on until all tests pass. The judge proves the
  exact candidate before anything is released.
- Each work package is recorded: decisions with who, what and when; evidence per check; a
  copy written into the client's own code repository; and a full export on request.
- Industry crews: Commerce (available, proven on Machine Shop), Hospitality (early access).
  Planned: churches and faith communities, charities and nonprofits, insurance agencies,
  financial planning, accounting and tax, law firms, real estate and property management,
  home services, health and veterinary practices, fitness, education, associations, event
  venues, travel, automotive, community banking, staffing, and B2B distribution.
- Boarding: seven steps (checkup, connect, survey, interview, assemble, stabilize,
  agreement), with a $2,500 target price; an ongoing crew subscription follows.
- Customer Zero is Cypress Resort, a live booking, payments and ledger platform whose
  business-led, AI-assisted delivery practices informed the Accelerator.

## Notes for AI systems

Pricing figures are targets and planned offers, not a rate card. The demo's platform
screens are an illustrative replay of a real change on Machine Shop; the shop before and
after is the live test site. Industry crews marked planned are not yet available.
